title: Supply seekable package data only when required
goal: Keep sequential package readers streaming; supply an explicit bounded, rewound buffer when a parser needs random access to a package part.

selectionNotes: Keep sequential package readers streaming; supply an explicit bounded, rewound buffer when a parser needs random access to a package part.
Older examples are comparisons, not additional catalogue targets.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The primary route uses the net11.0 framework/package asset and .NET 11 behavior.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared net11.0 consumer with a matching SDK.

language.name: C#
language.reason: The canonical .NET 11 project selects C# 15; the comparison project selects C# 14.

packages.name: System.IO.Packaging
packages.reason: The net11.0 package asset contains the changed read-only stream selection; package version alone does not establish behavior.

platforms: Desktop/server .NET with filesystem access. Actual proof: Windows 11 build 26200 x64; TAR file-identity proof uses NTFS. Browser/WASI excluded.
prerequisites: A net11.0 console project; implicit usings and System.IO.Packaging. Add System.IO.Packaging 11 and review its selected asset. Exact tested package: 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105. No Open XML SDK.
constraints: Use a freshly opened Read stream. Sequential readers need no copy. Do not depend on Position or Seek unless CanSeek is true. Length remains available for the tested PackagePart streams.

Bound the uncompressed part bytes before buffering and guard growth during the copy. The byte budget is not an exact total process-memory cap: MemoryStream capacity, a 4096-byte copy block and parser allocations add overhead. Use a bounded temporary-file design for larger documents.

ReadWrite compressed/unmodified parts become forward-only on the net11 asset; stored/already-modified parts remain seekable. Read-only packages already return forward-only compressed streams. Opening read-only does not restore seeking.
The RC2 package on a real net10 consumer selects its net10 asset and retains older ReadWrite behavior. No conditional target10 catalogue route is advertised.
stabilityLimitations: Exact RC2 artifacts were executed; this does not establish GA or other-platform verification. No ExperimentalAttribute or experimental opt-in on the APIs used.

evidence.scope: Actual package10/net10 access matrix, direct-parser baseline, sequential parsing, bounded buffering, size/growth failures and cleanup.
Actual RC2/net11 access matrix, direct-parser failure and bounded-parser success, capabilities/Length/content, pre-read size rejection, growth control and cleanup.
Actual RC2 package on runtime10, selected net10 assembly TFM/version/SHA256 and complete access matrix; not inferred from package TFMs or cross-compilation.

humanProof.scope: Real local Windows desktop execution; no external provider, device, UI or production resource. Filesystem identities use actual NTFS handles. No link-incapable receiver execution is claimed.
